title: Circle of Alpha-Particle Cluster Shapes in Neon-20
summary: Quantum states of Neon-20 are generally agreed to lie in rotational-vibrational bands of a cluster of five alpha particles. However, more than one cluster shape has been proposed as dominant at low energy. As relative motion within a cluster is soft in certain directions, we investigate how the low-lying rotational bands of Neon-20 can arise from a circle of clusters connecting favoured shapes: a triangular bipyramid, a square pyramid, and a $D_{2d}$-symmetric distorted tetrahedron -- a twisted bow-tie.
